reference_answer: Equity investments not recorded at fair value are measured using the equity method of accounting when required, or measured at cost with adjustments for observable changes in price or impairments (the measurement alternative). question: According to NVIDIA's 10-Q, what is its current competitive position in China's data center computing market as of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, and what products can it still ship to China?
reference_answer: As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, NVIDIA was effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, though it was still able to ship uncontrolled products to China such as gaming and workstation GPUs.
